moves.name: Fly
notes: Bowarrow is on the field for up to 90 frames (param_bowarrow.life), which is what ends the hit -- its script never does. Hitting something usually ends it sooner.

The arrow deals 4.5–9.9%. The figure in its script is not used: the engine sets the power from its params (param_bowarrow.power, param_bowarrow.power_add, param_special_n.charge_frame). Charging adds power_add a frame, up to charge_frame frames.
